config.label: Eight Sleep account email
config.description: Eight Sleep account email. Optional when configured with eight-sleep-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Eight Sleep account password
config.description: Eight Sleep account password. Prefer the setup command so this secret is stored in ~/.eight-sleep-mcp/config.json (chmod 600) instead of MCP client config.

config.label: Set to true to enable write tools (set_temperature, set_side, set_away_mode, snooze/dismiss alarm)
config.description: Set to true to enable write tools (set_temperature, set_side, set_away_mode, snooze/dismiss alarm). Default false (read-only).

config.label: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw
config.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured.

config.label: Optional SQLite cache toggle
config.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

config.label: Optional local token path
config.description: Optional local token path. Defaults to ~/.eight-sleep-mcp/tokens.json.

config.label: Optional override for the Android-app client_id default
config.description: Optional override for the Android-app client_id default.
